reuse.why: The change reuses recurrence conversion and weekend adjustment, but implements daily skipping separately in three consumers and duplicates holiday matching.

duplication.why: Daily skip policy is repeated in getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, and getDatesInRange, while server-side holiday matching repeats the shared predicate's logic.

placement.why: Handler registration and configuration plumbing fit their layers, but scheduling policy belongs in shared/schedules.ts rather than being repeated inside server handlers.

scope.why: The edits stay focused on the requested daily skipping, range handler, holiday configuration, and corresponding tests.

maintainability.why: Maintainers must coordinate three policy implementations and separate occurrence lookahead formulas instead of owning one shared occurrence-processing abstraction.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/schedules/app.ts implements blocked-day checks in getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange instead of sharing the isSkippedDay predicate introduced in shared/schedules.ts.

disguised_duplication.where: The same daily exclusion policy appears as array filtering in getNextDate and getUpcomingDates but as null-producing mapping in getDatesInRange; isHoliday splits out matching already embedded in isSkippedDay.

abstraction_drift.where: getDateWithSkippedWeekend gains a holidays parameter; getNextDate gains a daily-specific take ternary and two daily-specific filtering branches, while getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange independently implement daily exclusion and blocked-day detection.
